steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In January 2024, Equity Mates explained Altium’s suite, from PCB design software to a cloud data and supply chain platform, noting 82% of revenue came from design tools and about $60 million from its cloud product Octopod, a global parts search marketplace.

episode.title: Designing the AI revolution - Altium | Summer Series

views.text: In November 2023, a guest on Equity Mates described Altium as selling software engineers use to design printed circuit boards, outlining the core use case for its product.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: 10 stocks with Adam Keily & Owen Rask

views.text: In August 2023, Equity Mates said Altium makes software to design circuit boards and highlighted its transition to cloud with Altium 365, adding it reported strong results and benefited from AI-related demand.

episode.title: Earnings season highlights, individual stocks v an ETF, & should you read The Intelligent Investor?

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In September 2025, Equity Mates discussed how hundred-bagger retrospectives often cite traits seen in Altium, including high margins and sticky recurring revenue, as reasons companies can earn strong profits over time.

episode.title: The bull market for Australian small caps - Claude Walker

views.text: In January 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said Altium Designer was globally recognised and that Altium dominated parts of the SME market, suggesting durable positioning in PCB design.

episode.title: Designing the AI revolution - Altium | Summer Series

views.text: In August 2023, Equity Mates relayed analysis cautioning Altium was increasingly reliant on price rises in a mature PCB market, with strong competitors and a smaller addressable market than many tech peers.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In January 2024, Equity Mates noted Altium acquired the cloud platform Octopod in 2017 and had been migrating customers from upfront licences to subscriptions, showing a deliberate reinvestment and product strategy.

episode.title: Designing the AI revolution - Altium | Summer Series

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In January 2024, a guest on Equity Mates warned that as a growth company, any disappointment could shrink Altium’s multiple, so subscriber growth, enterprise wins and margins needed monitoring to gauge what expectations were priced in.
